title: Design Autocomplete
definition: An Autocomplete Search requires debouncing user input to prevent API spam, caching previous queries, handling race conditions (aborting outdated fetch requests), and complex keyboard navigation (up/down arrows).
simpleExplanation: The Google search bar. It predicts what you are typing and fetches results instantly, but has to be careful not to crash the server if you type 100 letters a second.

basic: What are the core requirements for Autocomplete Component?
intermediate: How do you handle edge cases and accessibility in Autocomplete Component?
advanced: How do you scale and optimize Autocomplete Component for millions of concurrent users?
trick: What happens to Autocomplete Component if JavaScript is disabled?

answers.question: Define Autocomplete Component.
answers.answer: A complex system design problem requiring deep architectural knowledge.

diagramContent:
sequenceDiagram
  participant U as User
  participant I as Input
  participant D as Debouncer
  participant A as API
  U->>I: Types "A"
  I->>D: Reset Timer
  U->>I: Types "Ap"
  I->>D: Reset Timer
  D-->>A: Timer expires! Fetch "Ap"
  A-->>I: Returns results
